_note: Starter thresholds inspired by general guidance (ADA, AHA, WHO, KDOQI, ICMR-NIN). They are EDITABLE and must be reviewed by a qualified dietitian before any real-world use. item_limits apply to one portion; meal_limits apply to the whole meal.

general.label: General healthy eating
advice: Fill half your plate with vegetables, a quarter with protein and a quarter with whole grains.

diabetes.label: Diabetes
advice: Pair carbohydrates with protein or fibre to slow glucose rise.

hypertension.label: Hypertension
advice: Aim for under 2,000 mg sodium per day (WHO).
Prefer fresh food over packaged or pickled items.

obesity.label: Obesity / weight management
advice: Prefer high-fibre, high-protein foods that keep you full on fewer calories.

heart_disease.label: Heart disease
advice: Replace saturated fat (butter, cream, ghee) with unsaturated fat where possible.

kidney_disease.label: Kidney disease
advice: Kidney diets depend strongly on disease stage - follow your nephrologist or renal dietitian's limits.

pcos.label: PCOS
advice: Favour low-GI, high-fibre meals with adequate protein to support insulin sensitivity.
